item.title: NLA vs Meltwater: CJEU issue ‘temporary copying’ decision
item.description: The Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) today announced its opinion on the “temporary copying” exception in UK copyright law. As we explained previously on this blog all other issues decided in the NLA’s favour remain unaffected.
